semiconductor_relevance: High — MZ Semiconductor Equipment specializes in metrology and inspection equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MZ Semiconductor Equipment (Wuxi) Co., Ltd provides advanced metrology and inspection solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on process control and yield management. Their product offerings include overlay metrology, automated patterned wafer defect inspection, bonding alignment metrology, and multi-functional 3D topography metrology, aimed at enhancing efficiency and reducing costs for semiconductor manufacturers.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Wuxi, with an R&D center in Shanghai and production facilities in multiple regions.
